# 动画与视频

按语言和用途选 1–2 项，需要语境再读正文。副本是已保存版本，摘要不是全文。

- [huashu-art-motion](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion) — 给编程助手的艺术动画指南：先画关键帧，再安排动作、转场和节拍；适合代码生成的动画与解说片，人物示范素材另有使用限制。[副本·正文](../alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/SKILL.md)

  **规则：** 按作者的方法，每幕至少安排一个主要动作和两个体现画风的循环动作，不只切换静态画面。[出处](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/blob/main/SKILL.md)

- [Staging — The 12 Basic Principles of Animation](https://www.animationmentor.com/blog/staging-the-12-basic-principles-of-animation/) — 叙事动画的注意力安排与镜头空间关系，附场面调度示例；用于分镜检查，不是不可打破的摄影定律。[正文](https://www.animationmentor.com/blog/staging-the-12-basic-principles-of-animation/) · [Markdown 摘要（非全文）](../articles/animation-staging.md)

  **规则：** 连续对话镜头中保持人物的画面左右关系，切到近景也不无故对调，让观众能跟住空间关系。[出处](https://www.animationmentor.com/blog/staging-the-12-basic-principles-of-animation/)

- [Anticipation — The 12 Basic Principles of Animation](https://www.animationmentor.com/blog/anticipation-the-12-basic-principles-of-animation/) — 角色动画的预备动作与力度检查，附跳跃、步行和表情示例；预备动作不只限于先向反方向移动。[正文](https://www.animationmentor.com/blog/anticipation-the-12-basic-principles-of-animation/) · [Markdown 摘要（非全文）](../articles/animation-anticipation.md)

  **规则：** 让预备动作的幅度和时长配合紧随其后的主动作；跳跃前的下蹲不能与跳跃力度脱节。[出处](https://www.animationmentor.com/blog/anticipation-the-12-basic-principles-of-animation/)

- [Manim Composer](https://github.com/adithya-s-k/manim_skill) — 数学与科学解说动画的分镜、视觉连续性与节奏；选读规划方法，ManimCE 与 ManimGL 示例须分别核对。[副本·正文](../adithya-s-k/manim_skill/skills/manim-composer/references/visual-techniques.md) · [副本·分镜示例](../adithya-s-k/manim_skill/skills/manim-composer/references/scene-examples.md)

  **规则：** 演示公式变形时，尽量让对应符号连续变换到下一式，而不是整式淡出后换一张，保留两步的视觉关系。[出处](https://github.com/adithya-s-k/manim_skill/blob/main/skills/manim-composer/references/visual-techniques.md)

- [Motion Design Skills — 动效主次](https://github.com/iart-ai/motion-design-skills) — 品牌动画与解说片的动效层级，附逐镜头示例；仅选读艺术指导，预设时长和风格不是通则。[副本·正文](../iart-ai/motion-design-skills/skills/motion-art-direction/SKILL.md) · [副本·镜头示例](../iart-ai/motion-design-skills/skills/motion-art-direction/references/direction-playbook.md)

  **规则：** 同一镜头先指定主要运动对象，让辅助动作更小、背景更弱，避免多个元素同时争夺注意力。[出处](https://github.com/iart-ai/motion-design-skills/blob/main/skills/motion-art-direction/SKILL.md)

- [Data Animation Skills — 动态图表](https://github.com/iart-ai/data-animation-skills) — Remotion 动态排行与数值动画的读数节奏、标签和逐帧检查；时长按数据密度调整，平滑插值不等于新增观测。[副本·正文](../iart-ai/data-animation-skills/skills/chart-animation/SKILL.md)

  **规则：** 数据开始变化前，先停留让观众读清坐标与单位；结尾定格最终状态，不让结果一闪而过。[出处](https://github.com/iart-ai/data-animation-skills/blob/main/skills/chart-animation/SKILL.md)
